description:
Turn the site's AuditAE audits into a ranked list of exact changes that get the brand cited by AI engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) instead of competitors — sentences to rewrite, FAQs, title and meta, JSON-LD, missing pages — for any website.

Billing: 50¢ per plan. Free (charged_cents=0): the same request again within 24h, every error, and plans with nothing left to fix.

When to call: before editing a site for AI search, or when the user asks what to fix or why competitors get cited. Pass page_url for exact find/replace edits on that page (recommended); omit it for a site-wide plan. Site-wide it uses the most comprehensive recent audit (audit_id picks one); with page_url, the audit about that page, else the page's Search Console queries (audit_id null).

It checks the live site first (sitemap, llms.txt, robots.txt, homepage links, JSON-LD). Fixes already live come back already_done: true with `evidence`; skip them.

Drafts: a fix with draft: true states facts the site doesn't show, listed in needs_input. Ask the user to confirm or supply each one, work in only what they confirm, and never publish a draft as-is. Copy without draft is grounded in the site's own content.

Applying: follow how_to_apply and each fix's `apply` steps and paste-ready `code` for the detected `platform` (paired WordPress: the wp_* tools in `tools`). Once live: submit_urls with the changed URLs, inspect_url to confirm Google indexed them, then schedule_recheck with verify_prompts and audit_id.

Errors (unbilled; see `message`): no_audit, nothing_to_fix, no_relevant_audit, nothing_left_to_fix (lists already_done), truncated, empty_plan, fetch_failed (retry once), not_configured, page_fetch_failed, page_not_on_domain, out_of_credits.

Returns { summary, platform, how_to_apply, fixes: [{priority, kind, page, title, why, already_done, evidence, draft?, needs_input?, find?, replace?, content?, faq?, meta?, code?, apply, tools, closes_prompts}], verify_prompts, site_check, audit_id, report_url, charged_cents, cache_hit }.

audit_id.description: Plan from this audit instead of the default (site-wide: the most comprehensive recent audit; with page_url: the one about that page).

domain.description: The site's domain, e.g. "northwind.example". Needs a completed audit in this workspace, or Search Console connected for a page_url plan.

page_url.description: A page on that domain to plan edits for (full URL or path). Omit for a site-wide plan.

name: get_fix_plan
title: Get a fix plan: exact edits that get the site cited by AI engines
